name: superpowers-architecture
description: Codex-only plugin for architecture-first development with GPT-6 Astra: project foundations, design, planning, TDD, reviews, and verified delivery.

interface.shortDescription: Architecture-first Superpowers for Codex and GPT-6 Astra
interface.longDescription: Take a project from a clear foundation through design, planning, implementation, review, and verification in Codex. Optimized for GPT-6 Astra with concise prompts and relevant reference loading. Autonomous execution is the default for new and existing projects; architecture, TDD, and review checks remain built in. Review-gated is an explicit opt-in. Phase Mode independently controls same-session or verified fresh-session progression.
defaultPrompt: Use wayfinder to establish my project foundation.
Use brainstorming to design and implement one bounded outcome.
Review my codebase architecture and recommend focused improvements.
